g.text: breath › Let a river of light run through the valley
Warmth spreads through Primordia. Around the valley, dawn spills across places that
never knew it. Here and there, sleepers wander into each other's dreams.
breath › Build a bridge of glass across the water
Warmth spreads through Primordia. Around the bridge, dawn spills across places that
never knew it. Here and there, a dream walks out into the morning.
A new landmark appears: The Glass Bridge
breath › Teach the dreamers to walk between the stars
The land exhales. Around the stars, dawn spills across places that never knew it. Here
and there, a dream walks out into the morning. Primordia has grown into its infant
Primordia grows from Newborn to Infant
Omen: Something old is waking beneath the light.
breath › A storm breaks and the shore is in ruin
The sky cracks open. Around the shore, rain falls upward for one long breath. Here and
there, a dream walks out into the morning.
breath › Heal the shore and plant a garden of hope
Warmth spreads through Primordia. Around the garden, dawn spills across places that
never knew it. Here and there, sleepers wander into each other's dreams.
A new landmark appears: The Shore of Light
Omen: Something old is waking beneath the light.
breath › Let the first people wake beside the river
Primordia listens. Around the river, the stars lean closer to look. Here and there,
sleepers wander into each other's dreams. Primordia has grown into its adolescent age.
Primordia grows from Infant to Adolescent
The world is ready for its first people
The Glass Bridge, The Shore of Light
